headword: お{調子者|ちょうしもの}
gloss: show-off; clown; someone who gets carried away

definitions.gloss: show-off, clown, person who gets carried away
definitions.explanation: A person who easily gets caught up in the mood and acts silly or boastful to entertain or impress others. Often used with a mix of affection and mild criticism.

examples.japanese: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{調子者|ちょうしもの}だ。
examples.english: That guy is such a clown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{調子者|ちょうしもの}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: He's a show-off, so he gets carried away easily.

examples.japanese: ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{調子者|ちょうしもの}がいて、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{笑|わら}わせている→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: There's always one class clown who makes everyone laugh.

notes:
お{調子者|ちょうしもの} describes someone who easily gets carried away by the mood and acts silly, boastful, or exaggerated to entertain others. From ⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧ (rhythm, condition) + ⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧ (person), with the polite prefix お.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{調子者|ちょうしもの}だ: is a show-off/clown
- お{調子者|ちょうしもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧くせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: even though (you're) a clown

REGISTER:
Can be affectionate or critical depending on context. When said with a smile, it means "class clown" or "life of the party." When said with annoyance, it means someone who goes too far or cannot be taken seriously.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to get carried away, to let success go to one's head
- ⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: in good form; also "smooth-talking" (of people)
- ⟦ムード→ムード：11160_muudo⟧⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧: mood maker, someone who energizes a group (more positive)
